description: Shows the user, in the local panel, a choice with 2–4 options and waits for the answer (the chosen labels and an optional note). Put the recommended option first, with « (Recommended)» at the end of its label. If the user does not answer, ask in the terminal.

multiple.description: true if more than one option can be chosen.

options.description: The options, the recommended one first.

description.description: What the option implies, with the reason.

question.description: The full question, understandable on its own.

name: ask_user
title: Ask the user for a choice in the panel
